reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000919 (the melody read from 000919a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Joseph Barnby's dates (1838–1896) are from our page for the tune GALILEAN (content/hymns/tunes/galilean.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1866. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000919a.nwc). The tune ends on G, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
